_note: Official ISO sources. Linuxify fetches checksum_url over HTTPS (it must stay on one of allowed_hosts), picks the newest file whose name matches the selector, downloads it from the same folder, and checks its SHA-256 before use. Pinned versions (Fedora, Mint, Ubuntu flavours, NixOS, AlmaLinux, Omarchy) need updating when a new release comes out. Last checked 2026-10-20.
